tool_input.command:
export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR='/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec105/fx' && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && export TMPPREFIX=/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec105/tmp/zsh && A=$(ls plugins/system-spec-harness/skills/assign-system-spec-completeness-evaluator/scripts/aggregate-completeness.py) && python3 -B $A --help | head -20; R=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json; python3 -B $A --report $R --spec-dir $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/system-spec --session e90cf7f2-108a-4d17-81f2-78ff44dc4b6a; echo agg=$?; shasum -a 256 $R; python3 -c "
import json;d=json.load(open('$R'));print(list(d.keys()));print(d.get('verdict') or d.get('overall'),d.get('spec_dir'));print(json.dumps({k:d[k] for k in d if k in('artifact_snapshot','evaluated_digest','input_digests','auditor_ledger')},ensure_ascii=False)[:2500])"
